def build_algorithm_kwargs(config):
    kwargs = dict(config)
    kwargs["num_learning_epochs"] = kwargs["num_learning_epochs"]
    return kwargs
proposal.rationale: The adapter omits num_learning_epochs from the algorithm kwargs, so the PPO update performs only one epoch per step instead of the configured 4 epochs. The measured actual steps [3, 3, 3] total 9 rather than the expected 12 steps for 4 epochs over 3 minibatches. The patch preserves all configured parameters by copying the full config and explicitly assigning num_learning_epochs from the local dictionary, without hardcoding epoch or minibatch counts.
